input.label: SUPPORTED

supporting_evidence.quote: Our 2025 server revenue was limited in Q4 2025 by our available supply of products due to Intel Foundry wafer fabrication supply constraints, primarily with respect to our Intel 7 and Intel 3 process nodes, impacting our ability to fully meet demand.

Our 2025 DCAI revenue was limited in Q4 2025 by our available supply of products due to wafer fabrication supply constraints at our manufacturing facilities, primarily with respect to our Intel 7 and Intel 3 process nodes, which impacted our ability to fully meet customer demand.

input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that foundry manufacturing supply constraints limited Intel's server revenue in Q4 2025. This is a causal/interpretive claim requiring explicit filing support for the attribution.

Evidence E1 directly supports this claim, stating: "Our 2025 server revenue was limited in Q4 2025 by our available supply of products due to Intel Foundry wafer fabrication supply constraints, primarily with respect to our Intel 7 and Intel 3 process nodes, impacting our ability to fully meet demand."

Evidence E3 corroborates this, stating: "Our 2025 DCAI revenue was limited in Q4 2025 by our available supply of products due to wafer fabrication supply constraints at our manufacturing facilities, primarily with respect to our Intel 7 and Intel 3 process nodes, which impacted our ability to fully meet customer demand." (Note: DCAI includes server revenue as confirmed in E1 and E2.)

Both passages explicitly state that (1) foundry/wafer fabrication supply constraints (2) limited server/DCAI revenue (3) in Q4 2025. The filing directly attributes the revenue limitation to the supply constraints, satisfying the causal nature of the claim.

The claim makes no numeric assertions - it is purely qualitative/interpretive regarding causation.
